gaps.note: no document shows the rear of this model: the data sheet has one photograph, of the front, and no manual is held. The data sheet's eight outlets are all on the front in the photograph, so nothing is known to stand on the rear.
gaps.wanted: a photograph of the rear, or the installation guide.

gaps.note: the photograph prints "ENV" and "Serial/Link" between the two black RJ45 jacks. Whether each label names the jack nearest it or the two read as one legend is not stated by any held document, and what each jack carries is not stated. Both are typed `rj45-serial`, the media the lint vocabulary has for a jack that is not Ethernet (the Ethernet jacks are the two labelled ETH 1 and ETH 2), because the labels say Serial and ENV and the data sheet calls the port "Universal (RJ45)"; no role, speed or pinout is given.

the data sheet gives no ear, bracket or hole dimension; the photograph shows an ear at each end with two holes visible on the right one. Only the flush position the photograph shows is named, without a figure.
a Visio stencil is held (its internal title reads PDU81001) and was not opened.
gaps.wanted: the stencil opened and compared with the front.

gaps.note: no document shows the top, the bottom or an end of this model. The photograph sees the top and the right end at a steep angle with ventilation holes along the side, which cannot be measured.
gaps.wanted: straight-on photographs of the top, the bottom and an end, with a scale.

capability.note: datasheet - "Outlet switching Yes" and "Switchable Metered-by-Outlets", so `outlet-switching: true`, each outlet states on and off, and the metering is per outlet (`metering-scope: outlet`).

chassis.note: datasheet - CyberPower PDU81001G data sheet, page 2: "433 x 44 x 112 mm" and "17.05 x 1.75 x 4.41 in." (W x H x D), "Rack Height 1U", weight 2.6 kg. THE EARS ARE NOT IN IT: the photograph shows an ear at each end outside the body, so 433 is read as the body between the folds. The finish is black.

controller.note: datasheet - page 1 features "Dual Network Gigabit 10/100/1000 Ethernet Ports"; page 2 "Hardware Connection Port RJ45 Universal (RJ45)", "Environmental Sensor Optional, via RJ45" and "LCD Multifunction LCD". The photograph labels USB 1, USB 2, ETH 1 and ETH 2 (10/100/1000), prints "ENV" under the upper black RJ45 jack and "Serial/Link" above the lower one, and a RESET legend over a dot above the navigation button. Which of the two black jacks is the environment jack is read from where the labels stand (gaps: env-serial-labels).

front.note: photo-measured - millimetres from the body's left edge and its top. Outlets: centres at 44.5, 73.8, 103.2, 132.5, 161.9, 191.2, 220.6 and 249.9 across (a 29.35 pitch) and 17.1 down; lamps 3.5 right of each centre and 36.4 down; numerals 1 to 8 beside the lamps. Cord at 17.8 across, 24.4 down. Reset dot 11.0 down and the navigation button 23.6 down, both at 303.0. Display 317.3 to 345.4 across, 10.4 to 42.2 down. USB 1 and USB 2 centre at 352.0 and 363.8 across, 14.2 down. The environment jack and the serial and link jack centre at 380.0, 14.2 and 35.6 down. ETH 1 and ETH 2 centre at 399.4, 15.6 and 34.7 down.

input.note: datasheet - "Input Plug Type NEMA 5-15P", "Cord Length (ft.) 12 ft (3.7 m)", derated input current 12 A, maximum 15 A. The plug style is not stated. The photograph shows the cord leaving the left end of the front.

method.note: ESTIMATED. NO DIMENSIONED DRAWING AND NO STRAIGHT-ON PICTURE EXISTS. Every position on the front is read off the one product photograph on page 1 of the PDU81001G data sheet, taken from the right and above, so it is NOT orthographic: x is read as a fraction of the body's width (1145 px for 433 mm, 0.378 mm per px, the ears excluded) and y at the face's own vertical scale (3.17 px per mm, 44 mm of face between the top edge and the bottom edge). The eight outlets sit on a near-constant 77.6 px pitch, which supports a common pitch across the block, but the controller block lies farther along the foreshortened direction and its positions are good to about 2 mm. The Visio stencil held for this model was not opened.

outlets.note: datasheet - the data sheet, pages 1 and 2: "8 x NEMA 5-15R", "Number of Outlets 8", "Outlets - Total 8". The data sheet does not say whether they are front or rear; the photograph shows all eight on the front, numbered 1 to 8 from the left. std/nema-5-15r@1 is the library's 5-15R face, borrowed from the 5-20R (no 15 A face is dimensioned), so the outlets are the part's size and not a reading of the photograph, where the face reads about 25 mm across.
